memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "But if, when the priest examines the sore, it does not seem to be more than skin deep and there is no black hair in it, then the priest is to isolate the affected person for seven days. On the seventh day the priest is to examine the sore, and if it has not spread and there is no yellow hair in it and it does not appear to be more than skin deep, then the man or woman must shave themselves, except for the affected area, and the priest is to keep them isolated another seven days." - Lev 13:31-33 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is a small detail worth noticing: they must shave themselves, except for the affected area.

Everything around the sore is cleared away so the sore itself can be seen plainly. The surrounding hair is removed — not because it was the problem, but because it obscured the view.

Sometimes God asks us to clear away what is around an issue so we can finally look at the issue itself.

We fill our lives with noise. There is always another commitment, another screen, another distraction that lets us avoid looking directly at the thing we know is there. We are busy — genuinely busy — and busyness makes an excellent hiding place. As long as we never sit still, we never have to examine anything.

That is part of why Scripture calls us to stillness. Be still, and know that I am God (Ps 46:10). Jesus Himself withdrew to lonely places and prayed (Luke 5:16). Not because activity is wrong, but because some things only become visible when everything else is stripped back.

If you sense God asking you to clear space — an evening, a morning, a fast from something — it may not be punishment. It may be Him shaving away the surroundings so you can finally see what needs attention.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What in your life is currently obscuring your view of something important?
2. When did you last sit in stillness with nothing to distract you?
3. What could you clear away this week to see more clearly?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, my life is full of noise and I use it to avoid looking at what matters. Help me clear space, be still, and see honestly what You want to show me. Amen.
